reserved_policy: Do not fetch or inspect before one qualified finalist freezes. Previously inspected BTC spot windows are development exposure, not final evidence.
cost_rationale: 6 bps taker fee per fill is a conservative research assumption, not an authenticated account rate. 2 bps adverse slippage per fill; 4 bps stress tests fragile small-range entries. Historical signed funding uses recorded mark prices.
screen_rationale: A research screen for fee fragility, sparse activity and dependence on one recent regime; these thresholds do not establish statistical significance or deployment confidence. 2026 fold ends August 31. Both recent folds must be positive under base costs; their summed stress return must be positive.
ranking: Qualified candidates first; then largest worst annual net return, then largest mean annual return. Always publish all failures and observed winners separately from qualification.
failure_route: If no candidate qualifies, RETURN_TO_PHASE_1 and preserve reserved data untouched. No performance-driven parameter changes or final test follow a failed approach gate.
optimization_gate: No Phase 4 optimization without an accepted immutable Phase 3 base and existing runtime baseline-backed authorization. This standalone engine is not registered with Mutation Lab.
target: Python research only; Pine parity NOT_APPLICABLE
limitations: Historical order-filter changes are unavailable; the captured current filters are a research feasibility envelope, not historical venue certification.
OHLC last-trade prices and idealized next-open market execution cannot certify live trigger, latency, partial-fill, liquidation, mark-price or order-acknowledgement semantics.
Stop-first dual-touch ordering is adverse. A funding credit with uncertain intrabar exit ordering is omitted; a debit is charged.
Risk is nominal stop risk including fees and slippage; gaps and subsequent funding can exceed it. Exposure cap applies at entry.
Each annual fold resets capital and position. Positions remaining at cutoff are censored and included through marked equity; no synthetic terminal liquidation.
No live or paper orders, account integration, profitability guarantee or discretionary SMC replication claim.

Missing API funding marks use official 5m mark opening quotes with a 1% adverse funding-notional buffer. This is a disclosed approximation; exact settlement marks and venue reconciliation remain unverified.
funding_data_adaptation: Before any economic trial, historical funding API returned blank markPrice fields. Preserve exact rates/timestamps and raw pages; join missing marks to official checksum-verified 5m mark-price candle open at floor(funding timestamp/5m). This is a causal opening-quote proxy, not exact settlement proof. Apply a 1% adverse funding-payment buffer: increase debits and reduce credits. Keep separate proxy counts/provenance and never use future candle high/low/close for funding marks. Full source census found nine missing funding opens on 2022-07-31, 2022-10-02 and 2023-02-24 in incomplete official monthly mark-price archives. Supplement only missing opens from checksummed official daily archives, retain monthly originals and a repair log. If daily data cannot cover them, block rather than borrow or fabricate.
